description: Extracts live local B2B business leads by category and city via NeonMaps (phones, websites, public emails, and no-website filter). Free metered tier returns up to 5 leads; upgrade via neonmaps_pro ($19 lifetime).

limit.description: Number of leads to return (max 5 on free evaluation tier).

location.description: City and state/country (e.g., Austin TX, London UK).

query.description: Business category or niche (e.g., dentist, plumber, marketing agency).

name: extract_local_b2b_leads
